children: Shares of Biomea Fusion slid after the company terminated its proposed public offering of securities.
The stock declined 16% to $1.44 on Wednesday. Shares are up 16% year to date.
The clinical-stage diabetes and obesity company said it determined that current market conditions aren't conducive for an offering on terms that would be in the best interests of its stockholders.
The company said no securities were sold in connection with the proposed offering, which it announced Tuesday.
